inputs.commit_message: Synchronize canonical workspace before direct P2P implementation
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
backup=$root/.local/direct-agent-recovery/20260831T200000Z
test -s "$backup/tracked.patch"
test "$(find "$backup/direct-src" -type f | wc -l)" -eq 14
test "$(sha256sum "$backup/tracked.patch" | awk '{print $1}')" = 91cdf30c8f4a62e74ba912aa1abefa2b641bd370c1fceee9bb224353371a3afc
git -C "$root" fetch origin main
git -C "$root" reset --hard origin/main
rm -rf "$root/packages/local-agent-core/src/direct"
printf '%s\n' '--- canonical synchronized ---'
git -C "$root" status --short --branch
printf 'head=%s\n' "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'originMain=%s\n' "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse origin/main)"
